{{Conjecture|legends}}
This '''asteroid base''' was held by the [[Nematiec Gang]] in the years leading up to the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. At some point before [[3999 BBY]], it was [[Raid on the Nematiec Gang's asteroid base|raided]] by [[Bogga's criminal empire]].
